goal: Extract the cohesive "affix" responsibility (prefix/suffix and related operations) from Strings into a new class AffixHandler. This moves a cluster of public methods that deal with startsWith/endsWith and related prepend/append/remove operations out of Strings to reduce the target class public method count and total method count.

expected_impact.rationale: Moving startsWith, endsWith and their related operations (startsWithAny, endsWithAny, appendIfMissing, prependIfMissing, removeStart, removeEnd) extracts a coherent responsibility (affix handling). This reduces Strings' public method count by 8 and reduces its total methods and LOC by extracting code into a focused class.

ops.details: Create a new class AffixHandler in package org.apache.commons.lang3 encapsulating affix-related public methods extracted from Strings: appendIfMissing, prependIfMissing, removeStart, removeEnd, startsWith, startsWithAny, endsWith, endsWithAny. The new class is instantiated with an ignoreCase flag so it behaves like the case-sensitive or case-insensitive Strings instances. The moved methods are removed from Strings to reduce its public method count and total methods. The extraction groups tightly related methods (prefix/suffix checks and manipulations) into a coherent responsibility class.
Move appendIfMissing implementation to AffixHandler. The method uses endsWith semantics which are moved alongside, ensuring local calls inside the moved code resolve to AffixHandler methods.
Move prependIfMissing implementation to AffixHandler along with its supporting startsWith logic.
Move removeEnd implementation to AffixHandler; it relies on endsWith which is moved as part of the extraction.
Move removeStart implementation to AffixHandler; it relies on startsWith which is moved as part of the extraction.
Move startsWith implementation to AffixHandler. The method requires the ignoreCase behavior; AffixHandler stores an ignoreCase flag passed via constructor.
Move startsWithAny implementation to AffixHandler; it depends on startsWith (moved) for its checks.
Move endsWith implementation to AffixHandler. The method requires ignoreCase behaviour and uses CharSequenceUtils.regionMatches.
Move endsWithAny implementation to AffixHandler; it depends on endsWith (moved) for its checks.

Update related tests affected by this refactoring block so the configured build command passes. Adjust imports, package references, moved class references, constructors, and assertions only when required. Do not change production behavior through tests.
